'''Inquiesse''' was the smallest continent on the [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] of [[Draenell's Point]]. Inquiesse was home to fifteen million inhabitants, including the three million living in the continent's largest [[City/Legends|city]], [[Juntrack]], and in various other cities throughout the [[Juntrack River]] valley.
